description:
Pedra is the AI photo and video studio for real estate agents. Connect your Pedra account and ask ChatGPT to prepare a listing's visuals.

Virtually stage empty rooms in the style you want, empty furnished rooms, renovate spaces with new floors and finishes, enhance lighting and straighten perspective, replace a dull sky with a blue one, remove objects, or blur faces and license plates. Describe any other edit in plain words, like "paint the walls sage green".

Pedra also turns a property's photos into a listing video with animated clips, background music, a narrated voiceover, and word-synced subtitles.

Everything you create is saved to your Pedra properties, so you can keep editing in the Pedra app. Requires a Pedra account; generations use your account's credits.

defaultPrompt: Virtually stage the empty living room in my property in a Scandinavian style
Make a vertical listing video from my property's photos with upbeat music and a voiceover
Enhance my listing photos and straighten the perspective
